The '''British Polling Council''' ('''BPC''') is an association of [[market research]] companies whose [[opinion polls]] are regularly published or broadcast in [[media in the United Kingdom]]. The current President is [[Jane Green (political scientist)|Jane Green]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=admin |date=2024-02-12 |title=New President For The British Polling Council |url=https://www.britishpollingcouncil.org/new-president-for-the-british-polling-council/ |access-date=2024-03-21 |website=British Polling Council |language=en-GB}}</ref>

The BPC was established in 2004,<ref name=parliament-20041216>{{cite web |url=https://edm.parliament.uk/early-day-motion/26936/british-polling-council |title=British Polling Council |id=EDM 407 |publisher=UK Parliament |date=16 December 2004 |access-date=2 September 2022}}</ref> twelve years after the perceived failure of opinion polls to come close to predicting the actual result of the [[1992 United Kingdom general election|1992 general election]]. BPC members use a range of fieldwork methods (telephone, door-to-door, and internet) and statistical tools.

==Members==

=== Founding members ===
The following organisations are founding members of the BPC:<ref name="bpc-members" /><ref name=":0" />

* [[Ipsos]] (formerly Ipsos MORI)
* ORB International
* [[Savanta]] (formerly ComRes) 
* [[Verian]] (formerly Kantar Public, originally TNS/System 3)
* Walnut Unlimited (formerly [[ICM Research]])
* [[YouGov]]

NOP (now [[GfK]]) was a founding member, but is no longer a member as of 2018.

[[Populus Ltd|Populus]] (now Yonder Consulting) applied to be a founding member<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.britishpollingcouncil.org/on-november-15th-the-british-polling-council-bpc-will-be-launched/ |title=On November 15th the British Polling Council (BPC) will be launched |publisher=British Polling Council |date=1 Nov 2004 |access-date=13 Sep 2026}}</ref> and the Yonder Consulting website claims that it was (e.g.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://yonderconsulting.com/poll/britain-under-strain-survey-february-2026/ |title=Britain Under Strain survey – February 2026 |publisher=Yonder Consulting| date=3 Feb 2026 |access-date=13 Sep 2026}}</ref>), but its name was omitted from the BPC press release listing of founding members.<ref name=":0" />
